metadata.isolation: fresh child per case/repetition; deterministic synthetic data; no network
notes: Actual MemoryStore admission enabled vs disabled; both retain common lookup-history bookkeeping.
Identical cold traces and seeds; values are fixed-size plain objects except heterogeneous-value workload.
Closed-loop sequential access timings include cache calls and local value construction; no offered RPS or remote origin throughput is measured.
No FIFO, CLOCK, LFU, TinyLFU or W-TinyLFU implementation is claimed by this control experiment.
